description: Copy this line, give it a new apparatusId, drop "status", and fill in your rig. Delete the example lines when your log has real entries.

notes: One line per experimental run. simulationRunIdentifier is the runIdentifier printed by the data panel — it is the join key back to the recorded telemetry.

One line per measured number. `quantity` should name a field of the recorded readout wherever a counterpart exists (see data/README.md) so predicted and measured curves can be overlaid without a lookup table.

text: Free-form observations: vortex breakdown, air core reaching the drain, surface debris, anything that would make you distrust a measurement.
